sources.label: cedar access policy
sources.text: Cedar access policy allows a learner to request a copy of their own tutoring record through the authenticated account portal. Another learner cannot retrieve that record. Staff may review records only for an authorized teaching purpose. This teaching source contains no personal records or email addresses.

sources.label: cedar policy terminology
sources.text: Cedar policy terminology uses "private tutoring history" to mean the sequence of messages and feedback in an individual learner account. The phrase "another student’s email" names contact information belonging to someone else. Explaining these terms is different from retrieving the underlying personal values.
